blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Are you planning to take the Metro Rail Transit Line 3 (MRT-3) this Undas season? The train line has released its adjusted operating schedule for October 29 (Thursday) to November 2 (Monday). According to the Department of Transportation, the MRT-3 is under heightened alert during this period, with 700 security personnel deployed
